options.prompt: The first image is the day version of a tea garden scene. The second image is the sunset version of the SAME scene: notice how it keeps the composition exactly identical to the first image — every plant, rock, pool, stream, and path is in the exact same place; only the colors and light changed. Now produce the NIGHT version of the same scene with the exact same discipline: the composition must match the first image exactly, element for element, position for position — nothing moves, nothing is added, nothing is removed. Only the colors change: deep indigo sky with a small crescent moon and a few tiny stars, deep blue-lavender grass and foliage, dark cozy greens, the pool reflecting pale moonlight, outlines deep warm brown. Flat matte kawaii style, no glow, no animals, no people, no text, no fireflies.
